record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare the INGRAIN ability: Victreebel (3 stars), Weepinbell (2 stars), Bellsprout (1 star). The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count. EffectEnum.INGRAIN (a Grass synergy effect) is a separate identifier and is not covered. Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Acts on the 3x3 block centred on the caster (caster's cell included): every same-team unit there (the caster itself included) is healed by a requested 15/30/60 (by stars), and every enemy there is attempted to be LOCKED for a base 4000 ms and then takes the same amount (15/30/60 raw) as SPECIAL damage. The cast target is not used for the area.

targeting.who: all units on the caster's cell and its up to eight neighbouring cells: same-team units are healed (the caster included), other-team units are locked and damaged; empty cells are skipped
targeting.note: The block is centred on the caster, not on the cast target; the target argument only gates the cast (range 1 here, so the target is adjacent anyway). Off-board cells are dropped.

geometry.shape: 3x3 square (Chebyshev radius 1) centred on the caster, centre included, clipped to the board

effects.target: each same-team unit in the 3x3 block around the caster, the caster included (ally branch tested before the enemy branch)
effects.scaling: handleHeal(heal, caster, apBoost 1, crit): x (1 + AP/100) of the caster; x critPower of the caster only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault false, so needs ABILITY_CRIT).
effects.resolution: applied = requested x AP x optional crit, then on the healed unit: x1.3 with BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED, x0.5 when burning, x0.5 when enraged, x1.2 in ZENITH weather; rounded; limited to the missing HP (the rest is overheal). A wounded unit, a dead unit or a unit with protect receives nothing. Big Eater Belt is not involved (it only changes stat changes).

effects.target: each other-team unit in the 3x3 block around the caster
effects.scaling: requested = table[stars-1] per enemy. handleSpecialDamage: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true); x critPower (reduced by Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite on the hit unit) only if the cast crit; x2 once with a DOUBLE_DAMAGE effect; x1.2 with STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT.
effects.resolution: applied = requested after those multipliers; PokemonState.handleDamage then applies attacker/field/weather multipliers, divides by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef), rounds up with a minimum of 1 and lets the shield absorb first; takenDamage = shield damage + HP damage (HP part capped at current hp), 0 when the unit has protect / skydiving / magicBounce. The lock is attempted before the damage. See knowledge/07367c34/core-mechanics.md section A.

statusEffects.target: each other-team unit in the 3x3 block around the caster

declaredRaw.label: requested base duration; attempted on every enemy, no chance roll

statusEffects.scaling: none from stars, AP or crit.
statusEffects.resolution: applied only if the enemy is not already locked, is not skydiving, has no rune protect, lacks IMMUNITY_LOCKED and has ccCooldown <= 0. The call passes the locked unit itself as the second argument, so enraged halving and duration reductions are evaluated on that unit. On success the enemy's range is forced to 1 (it is sent to the moving state first if its range was not 1) until the lock ends, when its range is recomputed and the crowd-control cooldown starts. The lock is attempted even when the following damage is blocked.

starBehavior.note: Heal and damage use the same table and are indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star value (120, also the ?? fallback) is not reachable by the bare factory star counts. The locked duration does not depend on stars. Whether other mechanics raise an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: Which units are affected depends on the caster's coordinates: off-board neighbours are dropped; allies and enemies in the block are treated differently; the caster itself is on the centre cell and is healed.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP; an enemy already locked is not re-locked and the timer is not extended; after a lock ends the crowd-control cooldown blocks a new lock for a while.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: heal 15/30/60 and damage 15/30/60 (1/2/3 stars), lock 4000 ms. Applied heal = requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional crit, then receiver modifiers (heal-received buff, burn, enraged, weather), rounded and limited to missing HP; wounded or protected units receive 0. Applied damage = requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional crit / double-damage / steam multipliers, then SPE_DEF division and minimum 1; takenDamage includes shield damage and is 0 for protected units. Applied lock duration depends on the locked unit's enraged state and duration reductions, and is 0 when the lock is refused.
